[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
William's inherited dates are 1784 for birth and 1865 for death; both remain uncertain. His mother is recorded in the existing account as [[Affleck-597|Unknown Affleck]], an unverified attribution which the possible Wandell and Lamington baptism below neither identifies nor excludes.

== Research Notes ==
=== Earlier date and family account ===

The earlier biography stated: William was born in 1784. He was the son of [[Affleck-597|Unknown Affleck]]. He passed away in 1865.

Those inherited claims remain in the research account, but have not been established by the record comparison made here.

=== Wandell and Lamington baptism comparison ===

A Findmypast derivative transcript records William Glasgow baptised on 19 September 1784 at Wandell and Lamington, Lanarkshire, with father William Glasgow and no mother supplied. This is a candidate baptism for William, not an established identification.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684962615 Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929, William Glasgow], baptism 19 September 1784, Wandell and Lamington, Lanarkshire; father William Glasgow; mother’s first name shown as “-”. Provider derivative transcript inspected 30 October 2026; original register not inspected.</ref>

The baptism is compatible with William’s uncertain 1784 birth year, but a matching year alone does not identify the child as the man who died in 1865. The transcript’s birth-year field does not supply an exact birth date. Its blank maternal field neither excludes [[Affleck-597|Unknown (Affleck) Glasgow]] nor confirms her as this child’s mother. The named father has not been identified with an adult profile.

The Thomas baptism of 3 November 1782 and William baptism of 19 September 1784 share a parish and a father’s name. Those details do not establish that the children were full siblings or that their fathers were the same man.<ref>Findmypast, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684963042 Thomas Glasgow, baptism 3 November 1782] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=R_684962615 William Glasgow, baptism 19 September 1784], Wandell and Lamington, Scotland, Parish Births &amp; Baptisms 1564–1929. Both derivative transcripts name father William Glasgow and supply no mother; originals not inspected.</ref> The original parish entries and the later death entries may provide identifying details.

The Scotland’s People link below leads to search results rather than a record-specific death entry. Its underlying evidence for the stated dates and maternal attribution has not been inspected in this review.
